title: Erudite v42 specimen v1.4: alt KS(beta-binomial) + tail q-grid

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from entropy_collab.adapters.erudite_v42 import compute_metrics_from_path

SPEC = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json'

def main():
    m = compute_metrics_from_path(SPEC)
    print("ERUDITE_V42_METRICS_V14", json.dumps(m, ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
